newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Q4 capex affected by project delays.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Q4 capex affected by project delays.

text.p: Australian December quarter capital expenditure was below the survey estimate due to the deferral of some significant projects, particularly construction projects in the mining, transport and storage industries, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
It said some other projects were also running behind schedule.

Total new capital expenditure in original, current price terms rose by 10.8 percent in the December quarter to reach A$11.34 billion, but this was 7.4 percent below expectations reported in the previous quarter.
The data showed private new capital expenditure fell 2.4 percent, seasonally-adjusted, in the December quarter to an estimated A$10.27 billion from A$10.52 billion in the September quarter.
Analysts had expected an average rise in December quarter capital spending of around 2.1 percent.
